verdict.rationale: Bugbot leaves inline PR comments with explanations and suggested fixes. Its documented apply path is "Fix in Cursor" and "Fix in Web" links, which open the issue in the Cursor IDE or cursor.com/agents rather than committing a diff directly from the PR comment. Missing for 10: evidence of native committable suggestion blocks (e.g., GitHub "Commit suggestion"), a true one-click apply-in-PR flow, and hands-on corroboration of the suggestion format.
